deskyard: use a Deskyard computer (a Linux desktop with a shared browser) from inside it or from anywhere else.

Usage: deskyard [-c COMPUTER] COMMAND [ARGS...]

New here? Run `deskyard guide` and `deskyard COMMAND --help`.

Desktop (screen, mouse, keyboard):
  screenshot [FILE|-]                  PNG of the whole screen
  zoom X0 Y0 X1 Y1 [FILE|-]            PNG of a region at full resolution
  size                                 print the screen size
  cursor                               print the mouse position
  move X Y                             move the mouse
  click X Y [left|right|middle]        click at X Y
  double-click X Y                     double left-click at X Y
  triple-click X Y                     triple left-click at X Y
  mouse-down [left|right|middle]       press a mouse button
  mouse-up [left|right|middle]         release a mouse button
  drag X1 Y1 X2 Y2                     left-drag from one point to another
  type TEXT...                         type text into the focused window
  key COMBO...                         press keys or shortcuts
  hold-key KEY SECONDS                 hold a key down for a while
  scroll X Y up|down|left|right [N]    scroll at X Y
  wait SECONDS                         pause for a while

Shell and files:
  exec [OPTIONS] -- CMD [ARG...]       run a command in the computer
  terminal [SESSION]                   join a shared terminal session
  shell                                interactive login shell
  cp SRC DST                           copy files to or from a computer
  forward [-R] PORT[:PORT]...          map TCP ports between this machine and the computer

Browser:
  browser connect [--port N]           forward the computer's browser to a local CDP port

Servers and sign-in:
  login URL [OPTIONS]                  sign in to a server, approving in the browser
  auth LINK [--name NAME]              sign in to a server with a login link
  logout [SERVER]                      revoke this CLI's credential and forget the server
  server list [--json]                 list the servers you are signed in to
  server default [NAME]                set or show the default server
  computer use COMPUTER|SERVER/COMPUTER set a server's default computer

Computers (on the server):
  computer list [--json]               list the computers you can see
  computer show NAME [--json]          show a computer's state and settings
  computer create NAME --image REF [OPTIONS] create a computer (admin)
  computer remove NAME [--delete-files] remove a computer (admin)
  computer start NAME                  start a computer
  computer stop NAME                   stop a computer
  computer restart NAME                restart a computer
  computer access NAME [USER=LEVEL]... show or change who may use a computer (admin)

Volumes (admin):
  volume list [--json]                 list the volumes
  volume create NAME                   create a volume
  volume remove NAME [--delete-files]  remove a volume

Accounts (admin):
  account list [--json]                list the accounts
  account create USER [OPTIONS]        create an account
  account update USER [OPTIONS]        change an account
  account remove USER                  delete an account
  account link USER                    make a new login link for a token account

Sharing:
  share list COMPUTER [--json]         list a computer's shares
  share create COMPUTER NAME [OPTIONS] share a computer by link
  share link NAME                      make a new link for a share
  share revoke NAME                    end a share

Signed-in devices:
  device list [OPTIONS]                list the signed-in CLIs
  device revoke ID [--account USER]    sign out a device

Information:
  status [--json]                      show the computer's name, state, image and screen
  guide                                short manual for computer access and control
  describe --json                      machine-readable description of every command
  help [COMMAND...]                    help for a command
  version                              print the version

Choosing a computer:
  Sign in to a server first: `deskyard login https://host/COMPUTER`. Commands then
  use a computer on a server: -c COMPUTER on the default server, or
  -c SERVER/COMPUTER (also --computer, before the command), else
  $DESKYARD_COMPUTER, else the default server's computer
  (`deskyard computer use COMPUTER`). $DESKYARD_URL + $DESKYARD_CREDENTIAL replace the
  default server. Inside a computer with none chosen, commands act on it
  directly.

Environment variables:
  DESKYARD_COMPUTER    computer to use when -c isn't given (COMPUTER or SERVER/COMPUTER)
  DESKYARD_URL         server URL, optionally with a computer (https://host/alice), to use instead of the default server; needs DESKYARD_CREDENTIAL
  DESKYARD_CREDENTIAL  client credential (dyc_…) for DESKYARD_URL
  DESKYARD_SETTLE      seconds screenshot and zoom wait before capturing (default 0.3)
  XDG_CONFIG_HOME      where servers.json lives (default ~/.config)

Exit codes:
  0      ok
  1      error (the message on stderr says what to do next)
  2      usage error (bad command, flag or argument)
  other  exec, shell and screen actions pass through the exit code of the command in the computer

Machine-readable: deskyard describe --json
